notes: Decision (per issue #38): ARCHIVE the cycle-artifacts convention. Path 1 (PR #42) eliminated the DELETE/PUT dance; PRs #43-#48 all merged through real CI without a cycle. The convention had structurally paused; this PR + the archive doc at scripts/cycle_artifacts_archived.md record the pause as deliberate.

Renumbering note: prior memory pr50-merged-without-workflow-2026-07-27 expected the workflow paste to land as PR #51. PR #51 is actually this archive (orchestrator opened it first under the autonomy directive). The workflow paste will land as PR #52+ after merge. The prior memory has been updated to reflect this.

Sacred files preserved: app/session_manager.py and app/test_session_manager.py untouched on main (verified via git diff main@e92c1e6 main@bbd3e8d -- services/auth-svc/app/session_manager.py services/auth-svc/app/test_session_manager.py → empty diff).

Why this is a meaningful PR even though it adds no product code: the cycle-artifacts convention was a structural pattern documented in 3 places (option3-cycle-script-template memory, github-issue-38 memory, several .gitignore rules). Removing it from the convention without recording WHY would have left future operators in the dark. The archive doc captures: (a) why it existed, (b) when it ended, (c) what replaced it, (d) how to resurrect it if a similar block ever returns.

Issue #38 was auto-closed by 'closes #38' in the PR title (GitHub's auto-close-on-merge behavior). The AC checkboxes on issue #38 were already marked checked in the archive doc itself (scripts/cycle_artifacts_archived.md has the explicit AC-1/AC-2/AC-3 disposition table); no separate gh issue edit is needed.

What did NOT change: live branch protection still has 2 required status checks ('test + lint + build' + 'docs structure + cross-refs'). The test-auth-svc workflow paste is still pending the conductor's human-side action (OAuth scope block). Once that PR (#52+) lands and merges, a separate ingest will register the new context.
